verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an email API, so bulk inbox triage is a fair question for this product. The evidence shows labels for tracking conversation state and full-text thread search, but nothing documents selecting many threads and archiving, labeling, or marking them done in one action, whether through the API, CLI, MCP tools or dashboard. IMAP client access is documented, but nothing shows that bulk actions in an external client map to AgentMail labels or archive state.
